text:
Maya: quick sync — shiproom greenlight slate. I pulled together the must-haves for GA readiness across SLA, docs, oncall, observability, and pricing. need signoff or clear blockers.
Liam: thanks. can you paste the short checklist here?
Maya: sure — core musts: 1) SLA definitions + exceptions doc, 2) runbook + oncall rotation assigned, 3) monitoring dashboards + alert playbooks, 4) pricing tiers + trial limits, 5) docs + quickstart + migration notes.
Priya: for SLA defs — do we keep default 99.9% availability for hosted and reserved 99.95%? any carveouts for maintenance?
Ravi: prefer to call them target SLOs and publish latency SLOs too. propose: hosted availability target 99.9, dedicated 99.95. maintenance windows documented as exceptions with 30m scheduled notice.
Sam: +1 on targets. need the wording for refunds/credits — legal asked for precise metric and window. I can draft the refunds section if you give me thresholds.
Maya: cool. threshold proposals: if monthly availability < target - 0.5% then credit 10% of monthly invoice; if < target - 1.5% credit 25%. keep it conservative for GA.
Liam: that seems reasonable. also we need to be explicit about degraded-mode fallbacks — e.g., if model variant replaced for availability, customers must be notified and SLA still applies.
Priya: on oncall — we need documented escalation path for customer-impacting incidents within 15 minutes. who is primary for week of ship?
Ravi: schedule: EngInfra will provide primary for first 4 weeks, product-ops provides backup. I'll update the rotation. Sam — can you verify pager permissions?
Sam: checking now. will confirm perms + add runbook links to the pager.
DeployBot: build 2026.03.20-386 succeeded on production-canary. no rollout triggered. :white_check_mark:
Maya: observability: retention ask from sales — 90d for critical audit logs, 30d for traces. ops worried about cost. thoughts?
Liam: default 30d for traces, 90d for audit logs seems ok if we gate 90d for enterprise-only with pricing add-on. avoids upstream cost for self-serve.
Priya: agree. also need per-route token cost telemetry in console before GA. customers asked for cost visibility.
Ravi: Optimize team to surface per-token breakdown by model+route. ETA end of next sprint?
Maya: is that strict blocker? product needs per-route cost by GA or we soften to "early GA" with clear note.
Liam: we can ship without fully granular per-route cost if we provide sample billing report + roadmap item. but mustn't promise exact per-route billing at GA.
Priya: docs: quickstart + migration FAQ must include: model pinning, private deployment network notes, and how fallbacks behave. I'll draft FAQ.
Sam: support readiness — playbooks for tier1 triage + SLA exemption flow. Also need runbook snippets for common perf regressions (cache cold, high token fanout).
Maya: OK owners: Priya -> docs + FAQ, Ravi -> oncall + escalation, Sam -> runbooks + pager perms, Liam -> SLA wording + refund schedule, Maya -> overall signoff and communications.
Priya: one negotiation item from enterprise: they want 99.99% for dedicated with contractual credits. that's a capacity + runbook ask. we should treat that as an enterprise add-on (not GA default).
Ravi: agreed — capacity-level SLA for dedicated can be a custom contract. default GA public docs show 99.95 target and note enterprise negotiable SLA.
Maya: final question — pricing. do we cap trial usage for self-serve to $500/mo credits and require sales-assisted for higher bursts?
Liam: cap looks fine. set rate-limit guard rails so bursts don't trip infra unexpectedly. also add quota clear messaging in console.
Sam: I'll add the quota and a soft-banner for approaching limits.
Maya: blockers callout: 1) legal signoff on refunds wording, 2) Engineer confirmation on per-token telemetry mitigation plan (Ravi), 3) oncall rota doc linked in runbook (Sam). If those are clear we can greenlight shiproom.
Ravi: per-token telemetry mitigation: we'll publish an approximation + roadmap. not a blocker.
Sam: oncall rota will be in docs by EOD tomorrow.
Liam: legal is queued; I expect signoff in 48h.
Maya: great. I'll assemble the shiproom slate and circulate to execs. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
